description: Set or correct the carrier and tracking number of the parcel the customer sends back. Changes only the fields passed; the return's status, stock and money stay as they are. Works while the return is requested, approved or received. For the order's outbound parcels use update_shipment. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

carrier.description: Carrier name; null clears it, omit to keep it

orderId.description: The id of the order the return belongs to (from list_orders)

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number; null clears it, omit to keep it

name: update_return_tracking
title: Update return tracking
